description:
The Far East, 2071.
The domain of the mad gods.

In the early 2050s, unknown life forms called “Oracle cells” begin their uncontrolled consumption of all life on Earth.
Their ravenous appetite and remarkable adaptability earn them first dread, then awe, and finally the name “aragami”.
In the face of an enemy completely immune to conventional weapons, urban civilization collapses, and each day humanity is driven further and further toward extinction.

One single ray of hope remains for humanity.
Following the development of “God Arcs”—living weapons which incorporate Oracle cells—their wielders are organized into an elite force.
In a world ravaged by mad gods, these “God Eaters” fight a desperate war...

(Source: Daisuki)

name.native: アリサ・イリーニチナ・アミエーラ

node.description: Transferred from a Russian branch, she is one of the new type of God Eaters. She has a lot of pride, will say whatever is on her mind, and may even be mentally unstable as time will show. In many incidents, she has failed her teammates by going into shock triggered by a past memory. Her parents were killed by an Aragami in the past, therefore she is extremely prejudiced towards them; particularly to Shio

The main protagonist of the story and A New-type god eater recruited by the Far East Branch. He cares for his subordinates so much that he forgets to take care of himself during a battle with the aragami. He is willing to give himself up for other people's safety. He soon is brought into the 1st Unit and learns a lot from his superiors. Lenka was named by his sister, Iroha Utsugi, after a flower that blooms from the mud.

The leader of the offense team.  Quick to joke around, but shows distinguished judgement and acting power in battle.    He holds a serious secret and was reported MIA (Missing In Action) during the Moon in the Welkin mission.

name.native: ソーマ・シックザール

node.description: A God Eater veteran at the age of only 18. Being so taciturn, he hates interacting with others. He is believed to have a much larger strength capacity than the other team members. Son of Johannes and Aisha Gauche.

Tsubaki joined Fenrir Far East Branch in 2059 and served as Captain until her retirement a decade later. She now acts as both the supervisor for the 1st-3rd units and instructs new recruits.

As a God Eater Tsubaki wielded a first generation ranged God Arc and was peerless in her achievements on the battlefield.

A mysterious pale girl who appeared before the God Eaters. Has a very innocent nature and likes to sing. She is also seen walking the deserts at the end of the animated promotion clip (God Eater Prologue).   ~!Perhaps the missing link between Human and Aragami. The weapon she uses manifests from her hands. It is later confirmed that she is a Human-type Aragami.!~

A 15-year old God Eater who joins the Far East branch the same day as the protagonist. He is an old-type and wields an assault gun formally used by [Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/44395/Amamiya-Tsubaki). He has a mother and younger sister, Nozomi, whom he cares for deeply.
The sub-leader of first unit. She is a top-rank shooter, and her god arc is a sniper (old-type; long range).

Kanon is well-known for her split personality. She is normally kind, friendly, and slightly clumsy but turns into a sadist during battle and shoots her Radial/Mortar Bomb bullets whether she hits an ally or not. She has been known to admit that some of her instances of friendly fire were on purpose. As a result Kanon has the highest misfire rate of the entire Fenrir Far East Branch.
Licca Kusunoki is a female mechanic of the God Arc Maintenance Crew.
